focus: Ability to become product insight, market analysis, or slide example

relevance.description: How closely the article matches the current topic.

scoring_guide.2: Some connection to the topic, but mostly peripheral.
scoring_guide.3: Moderately relevant, with a few useful topic signals.
scoring_guide.4: Highly relevant and clearly connected to the topic.
scoring_guide.5: Directly focused on the topic and strongly aligned with the research goal.

use_case_clarity.description: Whether the article explains who uses the product or feature, in what situation, and what the workflow looks like.

scoring_guide.2: A possible use case is implied but not clearly explained.
scoring_guide.3: A general use case is present, but user, scenario, or workflow details are limited.
scoring_guide.4: Clear use case with identifiable users and scenarios.
scoring_guide.5: Very clear use case with specific users, scenarios, and an understandable workflow.

problem_solution_fit.description: Whether the article clearly explains the pain point and how the product or feature solves it.

scoring_guide.2: Problem or solution is mentioned, but the connection is weak.
scoring_guide.3: Problem and solution are present, but the value is only partially clear.
scoring_guide.4: Clear problem-solution fit with an understandable value proposition.
scoring_guide.5: Very clear pain point, direct solution, and strong explanation of the value created.

actionability.description: Whether the article can become product insight, market analysis, competitor analysis, slide material, or a follow-up research question.

scoring_guide.1: Not useful for analysis or follow-up work.
scoring_guide.2: Limited usefulness; may only provide minor background context.
scoring_guide.3: Some useful insight for analysis or follow-up research.
scoring_guide.4: Useful for product insight, market analysis, or presentation material.
scoring_guide.5: Highly actionable and easy to turn into product insight, market narrative, competitive analysis, or a slide example.

credibility_novelty.description: Whether the source is credible and the article is recent, a new feature, GA, preview, partnership, or important market signal.

scoring_guide.2: Some credibility, but limited novelty or market signal.
scoring_guide.4: Credible and recent, with a meaningful product or market signal.
scoring_guide.5: Highly credible and highly novel, such as GA, preview, major partnership, launch, or important strategic signal.
